title: MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science
abstract: arXiv:2609.38392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. translated_title: MetaPersona：源自实证社会科学的任务导向合成人口
translated_abstract: 用于初始化LLM社会模拟的人格面临冷启动问题：现有方法缺乏一个有原则的依据来决定应包含哪些属性以及如何为这些属性赋值。因此，合成人口可能会错误地呈现塑造下游行为的人口构成、潜在属性和依赖结构。我们介绍了MetaPersona-DB，这是一个包含11,000多项实证人类被试研究的数据集，其中标注了任务相关变量、已报告的关系以及总体层面的人口统计信息。基于这一资源，我们提出了MetaPersona框架，该框架检索任务相关证据、构建源自文献的人格依赖图，并从连接人口统计学特征、潜在属性和结果的实证先验中采样合成人口。在三个下游案例研究、三个基线和三个前沿模型的评估中，结果因任务和模型而异：MetaPersona在（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对LLM社会模拟中人格合成的冷启动问题，提出了基于11,000多项实证研究的MetaPersona-DB数据集和MetaPersona框架，通过检索任务相关证据、构建文献驱动的人格依赖图并从实证先验中采样，生成更忠实反映人口构成、潜在属性及依赖结构的任务导向合成人口。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the cold-start problem in LLM social simulations by introducing MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies, and MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors.
